initial.right:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset: production pixel-art animation sheet for SARA, Yuuki's ADULT mother, in a classic top-down Unity RPG.
Input image 1 is Sara's USER-APPROVED IDENTITY: preserve her youthful adult face, soft BLUE eyes, pale BLONDE hair reaching the WAIST, simple white collared LONG-SLEEVED blouse tucked into a BLACK MID-CALF skirt, DARK tights, DARK-NAVY closed shoes, TWO WHITE FEATHERED wings. Preserve her adult proportions and garment lengths exactly: she is an adult mother, NOT a child or short chibi. Input image 2 is a different character Alice, ONLY a layout and cycle-rhythm guide. Do NOT copy Alice's face, hair, dress, ribbons or child proportions.
Art style: keep image1's polished crisp pixel art, subtle shaded volume and readable clusters, consistent colors and sharp contours. No motion blur, no redesign between frames.
Layout: a single transparent landscape sheet with FOUR equally spaced columns and THREE rows, ideally2048x1536, uniform4x3grid. Row1: FOUR ordered WALK frames. Row2: FOUR ordered RUN frames. Row3: THREE BREATHING IDLE poses in first three cells, fourth cell truly empty. EXACTLY11 full-body drawings. Every head, hair tip, wing, shoe and fingertip completely inside its own cell with generous TRANSPARENT GUTTERS; no overlapping adjacent cells. Equal head/body scale throughout, no cropping, no drawing in unused cell. True transparent RGBA outside sprites, not painted checkerboard, no scenery, no labels, no lines or floor shadows. NO HALO: Sara's light is a separate game asset; no glowing particles.
Motion: four consistent evenly advancing phases: contactA ->passingA ->contactB with OPPOSITE foot leading ->passingB ->contactA. Left and right shoes must alternate their lead. Stable bone lengths, shoe size, shoulder width and head silhouette. Walk small natural steps with soft reciprocal arm swing. Run modest faster steps, elbows slightly bent, tiny forward inclination; NOT jumping or giant strides. Her skirt covers the knees and ends at the same mid-calf length in every pose, swaying slightly with the legs; both dark tights and navy shoes remain visible under the hem. Do NOT shorten it, lift it dramatically or replace it with trousers. Hair and tucked resting wings sway gently, NO flapping or flying. No abrupt extreme pose or shape change between adjacent frames including frame4->1.
Idle: both shoes planted in the IDENTICAL neutral position across three frames, arms relaxed at SAME posture; only tiny chest and cloth expansion for relaxed ->tiny inhale ->tiny exhale. No walking legs, no head tilt, no wings opening. Mother has a gentle reserved expression, mildly tired but composed.

DIRECTION: EVERY pose faces SCREEN-RIGHT in the SAME three-quarter side camera. Both wings trail behind her on screen-left; a natural occluded far wing, both are white. Long blonde hair hangs to waist. Walk/run/idle all have the exact same right-facing angle. Do not turn the idle toward front. Side gait must clearly alternate feet, short natural stride under skirt.

motionCorrections.right:
Use case: identity-preserve. Corrective motion sheet for Sara, the adult angel mother. Image1 is her approved appearance; image2 is the existing directional animation sheet, whose walking feet repeat the same phase. Keep image2's exact camera, character, head scale and rendering, and image1's blonde waist-length hair, blue eyes, white long-sleeved collared blouse, black mid-calf skirt, dark tights, navy closed shoes, two WHITE wings. Draw the same Sara, no redesign, no halo and no weapon. Crisp dimensional pixel-art sprite shading, no blur.
Generate ONLY walk and run poses, no idle row. Exactly TWO ROWS: first row walk, second row run. Wide completely transparent margins between each pose and around the sheet. Preserve skirt mid-calf length, same leg length and head size throughout; both shoes fully visible below skirt. Hair and tucked wings gently sway, no flying or flapping. Neutral gentle adult expression, do not copy a child. Actual RGBA transparency, no labels, no grid, no painted background or ground shadow. Full body contained in every cell. No body deformation or extreme stride. The leg phases must VISIBLY DIFFER; no copying identical wide-stride silhouettes into all cells.
Direction: ALL sprites face SCREEN-RIGHT, same three-quarter side view as image2. FOUR COLUMNS, TWO ROWS, EXACTLY EIGHT FULL-BODY SPRITES. Ordered phases in EACH row:
1 contact: NEAR leg leads forward to screen-right, FAR leg trails to screen-left.
2 passing: NEAR shoe is directly BELOW pelvis supporting; FAR shoe sweeps forward with knee softly bent, both shoes CLOSE together below hem. Horizontal shoe separation much smaller than frame1.
3 opposite contact: FAR leg now leads forward to screen-right, NEAR leg trails to screen-left. Arm swing reversed compared with frame1; legs crossing/order differs visibly.
4 opposite passing: FAR shoe directly BELOW pelvis supporting, NEAR shoe sweeping forward with knee bent; shoes again CLOSE together. Loop4->1.
Walking stride modest, running stride a little larger with bent elbows and slight forward lean. Strong contrast between contact frames1/3 and feet-together passing frames2/4. Do not draw all four with legs spread. Registered head, stable skirt length, natural adult leg lengths. Walk/run each have four distinct evenly progressing phases.
